name: Replicate
tagline: Run image, video, audio, and language models via API.
shortDescription: Replicate provides a hosted model API, webhooks, files, deployments, and an official CLI.
agentSummary: Agents can run many media and AI models, inspect predictions, and automate model deployments through API or CLI.
bestFor: Image/video/audio generation, model demos, and hosted inference jobs.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: Model licenses, output safety, and per-model cost/latency vary widely. Model behavior, costs, rate limits, data retention, and safety policies can change by model and account tier; use evals, spend caps, and data controls for sensitive workloads. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. API automation needs client-side throttling, idempotency where supported, pagination limits, retries, and audit logging.
pricingSummary: Usage-based pricing by model hardware and runtime.
accountCreation: Self-serve signup; billing required for sustained usage.
browserSupport: Web UI is helpful for model discovery and prediction inspection.

capabilities.detail: CLI supports running and managing Replicate workflows.
HTTP API supports predictions, models, deployments, files, and webhooks.
Docs include model, webhook, and deployment examples.
Usage-based pricing by model hardware and runtime.
Self-serve signup; billing required for sustained usage.
Web UI is helpful for model discovery and prediction inspection.
The tool has documented test, local, preview, self-hosted, or staging paths that let agents validate changes away from production.
